Sr Engineer R&D Firmware (m/f/d)
Visit employer website
About this job
About The Role
Would you like to help shape the next generation of safety-critical control systems, contribute your ideas and expertise in functional safety and cybersecurity, and take on real technical responsibility? Are you passionate about embedded systems and firmware development? Do you enjoy working in agile, self-organized teams and thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment?
Then this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for. We’re already on the journey — and we invite you to join us!
We’re seeking a talented and experienced Firmware Engineer / Embedded Software Developer to strengthen our innovative team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, verification, and validation of firmware and embedded software for our next generation of safety-critical control systems. You will work closely with hardware engineers, product owners, and other team members to develop efficient, reliable, robust, and high-performance embedded systems.
Responsibilities
Independent development of complex firmware solutions
Architecture and design of firmware systems
Drive improvements in software quality, testability, maintainability, and reliability
Mentor and support junior developers
Provide technical leadership on projects
Collaborate closely with hardware engineers, product owners, and other stakeholders
Optionally, take on team leadership responsibilities in the medium term
Requirements
At least 5 years of professional experience in firmware development
Strong programming skills in C/C++
Extensive experience with modern microcontroller architectures
In-depth understanding of real-time operating systems (RTOS)
Experience in functional safety and/or cybersecurity
Good knowledge of communication protocols
Experience with version control systems, such as Git
Bereitgestellt in Kooperation mit der
Bundesagentur für Arbeit.
